name: TransmogAppearance
aliases: masked-map element of the appearance sets
summary: One element of an appearance-set map: a prefix-varint id, a strict zero-or-one presence byte with its optional prefix varint, and one big-endian u64 that the mask bit declares present. The u64 reads as a 64-bit appearance bitmap; that reading is an interpretation, not a measurement.
purpose: Give the appearance-set map a named element card so the container is masked_counted(nested(...)).

fields.name: id
fields.note: Read by 0x14087b910 in the 0x14365f1e0 element loop. Measured ids run 0..32 then 44, 45, 46, 48, 52, 54, so it is the map key; what the key indexes is not established.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: A strict zero-or-one presence byte through FUN_1461adf60 followed by one prefix varint when it is 1; the writer 0x143658440 delta-codes it against the previous element and writes the client's 'unchanged' sentinel instead. The first measured element carries 01 11 (17), the rest 00.

fields.name: value
fields.note: The masked u64, read by 0x14087af30 (eight raw bytes through the byte-swap FUN_146168b00). Measured first element 0x0194f018811f0000. The values carry single bits and short bit runs, consistent with a 64-bit appearance bitmap, but no field is named.

evidence.ref: 0x14365f1e0 reads id through 0x14087b910, presence through 0x1461adf60 and the value through 0x14087af30 (build 30fe6461).
